headline: Citrix and Ivanti patch critical flaws; Poland shuts ePUAP after cyberattack; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12, Barracuda ESG due 11-13

bullets.text: New: Citrix and Ivanti released patches for critical and high-severity vulnerabilities (SecurityWeek). Asus and Zoom also shipped security patches today.
New: Poland shut down its government services platform ePUAP following a cyberattack. Also still developing: Maersk is investigating an IT security incident with data theft.
Due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.
Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) are exploited in attacks (4 outlets); KEV due 11-13. Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 is also due 11-13.

N-able has released hotfixes for the N-central zero-days a researcher published (4 outlets). Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave Webtop CVE-2026-111793 are exploited despite patches; KEV due 11-24.

Still active: Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets), Ridgecrest Regional Hospital offline, two US school districts shut systems; 35,000+ Grok-built apps exposed online. The week ran 1.14x the 90-day average.

actions: Review the new Citrix and Ivanti advisories and patch internet-facing Citrix and Ivanti appliances first; apply the Asus and Zoom updates.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure too.
N-able N-central customers: apply the zero-day hotfixes now and review RMM activity for misuse.
Patch Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop, roll out Microsoft's November updates (Outlook CVE-2026-124194 first), and update Chrome.
Inventory internet-exposed AI-generated apps, lock down access and rotate any secrets they hold.
